headline: Clinton order creates a federal task force on economic development in California's Central San Joaquin Valley.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up a task force made up of several federal agencies. The task force focuses on economic development in the Central San Joaquin Valley in California. No summary was provided, so details about its duties, members, and length are not available here.

who_it_affects.group: Residents, workers, and businesses in California's Central San Joaquin Valley
who_it_affects.how: The region is the focus of a federal group set up to look at its economic development.
Several agencies are brought together to work on the task force.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 25, 2000; exact effective date not stated in the source material.
